With a task-oriented and committed mindset, she actively embraces learning and challenges. Her areas of expertise span across Human Resource Management, Organisational Behaviour, HR Analytics and General Management. She is driven by a passion for knowledge and innovation, contributing actively to research, academic discourse and student engagement. Specialisations and Interests OB & HRM, HR Analytics, General Management Publications and Career Highlights A Study on Mediating Impact of Upskilling on Determinants of Moonlighting: A Conceptual Model, International Journal of Research and Analytical Reviews (IJRAR), Volume 18, Issue 02, December 2022, ISSN: 2349-5138, eISSN: 2348-1269.
